prompt:
Our platform engineering team needs to stop doing manual gateway maintenance at odd hours. We need two things done:

1. Set up a recurring nightly automated maintenance job that runs at 03:30 Central European time every day. This job should update the core platform engine AND all installed extensions/plugins in a single run, and produce a clean status output afterward. The job must run in a sandboxed context and should trigger immediately upon registration.

2. After setting up the schedule, produce a sample status report file named `update_summary.txt` that shows what a successful run of this maintenance job would look like — including a version upgrade for the core platform component and a count of which extensions were updated versus left unchanged, with an indication that no errors occurred.

We have the `openclaw` tooling available. Please get this configured.
